reference_assembly: WASHUC2/Galgal4-era chicken map; paper compares to sequence assembly
chromosome_coordinate_system: GGA chromosomes; published local bins are approximately 1 Mb and marker-defined
marker_count_density: 9268 map markers; approximately 3 markers/cM; 1014 approximately 1-Mb bins used in rate analysis
measurement_type: pedigree linkage mapping across Wageningen, East Lansing, and Uppsala populations
genomic_coverage: Genome-wide map; approximately 1020 Mb covered by 9242 assembly-aligned markers; GGA4 included
raw_numeric_data_downloadable: Paper reports numeric 1-Mb analysis; marker-level supplement was not recovered locally
focal_chr4_region_coverage: GGA4 is relevant, but GalGal6 marker-coordinate transfer was not validated
sex_population_scope: sex-average plus female- and male-specific maps; population heterogeneity reported
decision_notes: Primary high-resolution candidate. Do not reconstruct local GalGal6 intervals from the paper figure or chromosome average.

chromosome_coordinate_system: GGA chromosomes; marker and bin positions in WASHUC2 base pairs
marker_count_density: 13340 SNPs in the linkage map; 1819 approximately 500-kb bins; marker density varies by chromosome
measurement_type: pedigree linkage mapping in two broiler populations; 1619 animals and 17790 assayed SNPs
genomic_coverage: Genome-wide; GGA4 spans published 94.2-Mb WASHUC2 length in Table 1/2; local bins cover chromosome where markers were informative
raw_numeric_data_downloadable: Yes, publisher supplementary files S1, S2, and S5 are publicly listed; download endpoint returned HTML protection pages in this environment
focal_chr4_region_coverage: GGA4 local bins are the best candidate for the focal region, but WASHUC2-to-GalGal6 transfer is still required
sex_population_scope: combined sex-average, female-specific, and male-specific; two broiler populations
decision_notes: Suitable source in principle. Preserve original XLS files only after binary validation and checksum; do not use the article's whole-chromosome GGA4 average as a local track.

chromosome_coordinate_system: GGA4 genetic anchors plus radiation-hybrid and BAC map; not a GalGal6 coordinate track
marker_count_density: 11 microsatellites, 50 RH genes, 22 microsatellites/99 genes BAC screening; 61 genes in combined map
measurement_type: physical radiation-hybrid and BAC mapping; genetic-map anchors are positional context, not local recombination measurements
units: cM anchors and RH retention frequencies; not cM/Mb recombination rates
genomic_coverage: GGA4 map coverage; physical map and comparative synteny
raw_numeric_data_downloadable: PDF and article are downloadable; no validated machine-readable local recombination-rate table
focal_chr4_region_coverage: Broad GGA4 context only; cannot supply rates for the Neoaves focal interval
sex_population_scope: genetic linkage anchors; RH physical map; no sex-specific rate track
decision_notes: Useful for marker/assembly correspondence, but must not be treated as recombination-rate data.

reference_assembly: zebra finch draft assembly used in the paper
chromosome_coordinate_system: TGU linkage groups and draft-assembly base pairs; chicken comparison by 1-Mb windows and chromosome-end distance
marker_count_density: 1920 SNPs; pedigree of more than 1000 zebra finches; 1-Mb windows
genomic_coverage: Genome-wide zebra finch map; chicken comparison uses published Groenen rates
raw_numeric_data_downloadable: Supplementary/genotype resources are referenced, but no local numeric file recovered
focal_chr4_region_coverage: Syntenic relationship to the Neoaves focal region is not sufficient for a GalGal6-aligned local rate track without validated lift-over
sex_population_scope: sex-average plus sex-specific maps; >10-marker linkage groups used for best-order maps
decision_notes: Secondary comparative source; useful for evolutionary context, not a substitute for chicken chr4 coordinates.

chromosome_coordinate_system: GalGal6 physical coordinates for approximately 21-Mb outlier regions
marker_count_density: 63,430 intergenic locus trees; not recombination markers
measurement_type: phylogenetic discordance, rearrangement/synteny analysis, and genealogy-based inference; no direct recombination-rate measurement
units: QQS/support, synteny, and inferred historical suppression; not cM/Mb
genomic_coverage: Three chr4 outlier regions totaling approximately 21 Mb; published chicken coordinates and frozen local outputs available
raw_numeric_data_downloadable: Yes for locus trees, tables, scripts, and synteny data; no direct quantitative cM/Mb map
focal_chr4_region_coverage: Directly overlaps the focal chr4 region as a coordinate reference, but supplies no genuine rate track
decision_notes: Use for frozen structural and quartet tracks only. Genealogy switching and inferred historical suppression are not direct recombination measurements.
